purpose: Correct V1's single-parameter-draw failure mode and freeze 100 genuinely diverse topology parents with exact family identity before any mesh or LiDAR generation.

approval.scope: One topology-only V2 audit of 120 fresh predeclared candidates; bounded 20 parameter draws per requested tunnel, 100 Cano internal trials per draw, exact cycle-rank equality, first 10 valid per stratum, 80/10/10 parent split; no mesh, LiDAR, labels or training.
approval.confirmation_reference: User repeatedly replied 继续 after receiving the exact fresh-seed, 20 parameter-draw, 100 internal-trial, exact-cycle-rank and zero mesh/LiDAR/training V2 scope.

source.method: Native random grown/connector primitives through a read-only audited adapter with bounded deterministic parameter rejection sampling.
source.benchmark_exclusion: All M-TARE official comparison worlds and project benchmark worlds are excluded.
source.historical_parent_policy: P01-P05 and all 60 V1-valid parents are diagnostic predecessors only and are excluded from V2 candidates and final split.

candidate_scope.selection_and_split: First 10 machine-valid per stratum; accepted ranks 1-8 train, 9 validation, 10 development_test. Fewer than 10 in any stratum is batch FAIL.

leakage_controls: Topology parent is the split atom; all future descendants inherit the split.
Only the first accepted train parent in each stratum may be rendered for human review.
No V1 result or benchmark world influences V2 seed addition, threshold selection or parent substitution.

evidence.machine: All 120 outcomes, every parameter draw and native API return, graph/spline metrics, exact cycle rank, canonical/WL hashes, replay and split audit.
evidence.visual: Exactly 10 complete X-Y/X-Z graph/spline maps, one first accepted train parent per stratum.
evidence.failure: Complete all predeclared candidates, seal FAIL if any stratum has fewer than 10 or a batch criterion fails; do not append seeds or silently change the draw budget.

next_stage_boundary: PASS only authorizes a separate perception-mesh proposal. It does not authorize LiDAR, labels, dataset export, training or planner integration.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only topology construction and accepted-parent replay.
